description: The round-2 fix eliminated patch_val.clone() in chat.rs, contact.rs, message.rs, position.rs, and presence.rs by switching to args.as_object_mut().and_then(|m| m.remove("update")). ban.rs, emoji.rs, and invite.rs were not updated and still use args.get("update").and_then(|v| v.as_object()), borrowing the map and forcing id_str.clone() on every successful/failed operation in the loop body. This creates inconsistency within the same crate: five handlers own their loop variable, three borrow it. The fix in those three files requires the same ownership change: switch to remove or as_object_mut().and_then(|m| m.remove("update")), then drop the id_str.clone() calls throughout the loop. ban.rs is particularly verbose: every branch in the Ok(Some)/Ok(None)/Err match clones id_str.
title: ban.rs/emoji.rs/invite.rs: update loop still uses borrow pattern, forcing id_str.clone()
